title: On the Road Again
subtitle: Bubblegum? A gas station? Or ... a set of drums?

items.text: On the Road Again

items.speaker: Flash Lianna
items.text: Hey, um ... Captain, before we go, we don't really know much about you.
She stamps out a spark at her feet. Not far away, the rest of the band is waving off some of the other kids from the club.

items.speaker: Flash Lianna
items.text: But it doesn't matter. I didn't know anyone here at first either.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Yeah? How did all of you end up together?
In the parking lot nearby, the engine of Riley's car revs up.

items.speaker: Flash Lianna
items.text: The way I heard it, Johnny just spotted her in a bar one night, walked right up to her, and said, "Hey, wanna start a band?"

items.speaker: Flash Lianna
items.text: He's like gum, sticks to whoever he chooses. Right, Johnny?
Johnny wipes a bead of sweat from his forehead while he loads up the truck.

items.speaker: Four-Finger Johnny
items.text: If you've got time to chitchat, you've got time to haul this gear!

items.speaker: Flash Lianna
items.text: Chitchat? Whatcha talking about? The captain and I are strategizing here.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: About the show, I sing too, don't I, APPLe?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Ahem! *cough*
His response is politely noncommittal.

items.speaker: Flash Lianna
items.text: Oh, you wanna be a part of the show? I guess I thought you'd be off doing pirate-y things.

items.speaker: Flash Lianna
items.text: Y'know like grabbing a gun and storming the control room like a real badass.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: No ...

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: I'm not the action and explosives sort of pirate, a few pyrotechnics excepted.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: But I do have my ways, I—

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Hey!

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: The car's ready. Are we all set up?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: The captain was discussing the crew's assignments with Lianna.

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: Right on! So, what am I doing?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Hang about ... Aren't you singing?

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: I ... just can't. Not now.
Regulus goes uncommonly silent for a passing instant before springing back to life.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: No worries, love! Then your rockin' pirate friend will take the mic and blow those goons away on your behalf!

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: Awesome. Count me in for whatever else I can do.

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: Hop in, Captain.

items.speaker: Flash Lianna
items.text: What gives, I'm not riding shotgun?

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: Nah. Someone needs to make sure Johnny doesn't crash the truck; we need our gear all in one piece for this show.

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: You know, I was a DJ too, once upon a time. Had my own show at nine every night. "Don't touch that dial! You're listening to the Hard Rock Hour with Riley."

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: But that was before the town got taken over by those crazies. At first, it was just some restrictions on what I could play, but eventually, they started writing the set lists themselves.

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: So, I gave them the finger and went back to my old job.

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: Then I met Johnny, and he convinced me to join his band. Fight the power with music.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Radical, sister. I always knew we were two of a kind. Musical freedom fighters!

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: Too right, mate.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Y'know I'm chuffed to be able to sing with your band. But, you ought to know, it should be you up there.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: But if you just want to be our wheelwoman and drive us around, that's still fab.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: End of the day. We're in this fight together. Just let'em try to stop us!

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: Hahaha, thanks, Regulus. You know, there's a story behind this car.

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: My boozehound dad used to run "deliveries" with it—call it smuggling if you like.

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: He loved music; can't remember a time there wasn't Charles Mingus, Elvis Presley ... even Freddie Mercury playing when he pulled in from work.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: So that's where you got your love of rock'n'roll, eh? Your dad?

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: Maybe, I guess I just started to connect the sound of that music with him coming home. Rock became the rhythm of my childhood, until ...
Her words fade out into the soft rumble of the engine as they drive toward their destination.

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: Maybe we should have all just piled into that truck. Would've been safer.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: You're safe as houses; you've got us two riding with you!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: This rockin' pirate captain held off the Foundation itself once, when they came a-knocking!
She brags further about her "glorious exploits"—her brave standoff in the forest.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: And that was far from even my greatest exploit, but I admit the recent ones were more of a team effort.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Still, I'd say we've proved our punk credentials, haven't we, Mr. APPLe?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Yes, I believe that would be an accurate use of the term "punk."

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: So, then this is far from your first rodeo.

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: But do you think we can really make a difference, or are we just making noise?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Noise? Not a chance! Defiance against all odds. That's the true pirate way!

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: I'm starting to think you really are a pirate.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: As a matter of fact, the captain did own a ship engaged in illegal activities.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Not just one, mate! Don't forget our dearly departed APPLe II!
Two generations of APPLe lost to the deep, one in battle and one battling through storms.

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: That must've been heartbreaking. I can't imagine what I'd feel like if I lost this old jalopy.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: It doesn't matter none. This rockin' pirate won't be stuck shoreside forever.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: We should consider making an application with the Foundation; I'm certain the Timekeeper would be happy to assist, though based on my understanding of the Foundation's current financial state, Captain ...

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: I recommend we not hold our proverbial breath.

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: The Foundation? So, what are you, a licensed pirate now? Haha!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Historically, this APPLe believes the term would be "privateer."
Their vessel bobs over potholes like waves on a choppy sea.
Whether it's the rocky road or their looming destination, Regulus notes the grip her helmsman has on the wheel.
And on land or sea, any captain worth her salt knows what calms nerves on the eve of battle.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: "Hey, pal, quit feeling so blue."♪

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: "Sing away the sadness, let the joy shine through."♪

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: Bahahaha, I gotta say, Miss Regulus, if you're going to be the lead singer ...

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: You're definitely about to bring down the house.

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: It's just up ahead. Let's hop out here.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Brill! Now to give these knuckle-dragging jackboots a real blowout show.
